operations.name: GetMyAccount
operations.summary: The signed-in person's own account.

operations.name: ListAccounts
operations.summary: Page through accounts, optionally by status. Administrators only.

operations.name: BrowseFeatureKinds
operations.summary: The kinds a geographic feature can have, in code order, for choosing a feature type.

operations.name: BrowseFeatures
operations.summary: Browse geographic features with their names, optionally of one type or by code prefix.

operations.name: BrowseGeometries
operations.summary: The current drawings whose envelope meets a map's bounds and whose zoom range includes the zoom, optionally of one feature type and simplified to a tolerance.

operations.name: GetFeature
operations.summary: One geographic feature with its names.

operations.name: ListFeatureGeometries
operations.summary: The current drawings of one feature, each with its role, basis, revision, confidence, zoom range and validity. A feature with no drawing returns an empty list.

operations.name: BrowseInstitutions
operations.summary: Page through public institutions with their names, optionally by code prefix.

operations.name: GetInstitution
operations.summary: One institution with its mandates and offices.

operations.name: GetOffice
operations.summary: One office with everyone who has held it, newest first.

operations.name: BrowsePlaces
operations.summary: The country's hierarchy one level at a time (county, constituency, ward, town, village), with the path to the current unit.

operations.name: GetCompareOptions
operations.summary: Places worth comparing a place with: the ten closest by geography, the ten top performers, and the ladder of the units above it, saying plainly which rungs do not exist.

operations.name: GetComparison
operations.summary: Two places on the same figures, aligned, with the difference in percent.

operations.name: GetContent
operations.summary: One explanatory text by its address or by the record it is about, with image references resolved to addresses.

operations.name: GetElection
operations.summary: One election: its contests, and results by unit under a parent, for tables and heat maps.

operations.name: GetGovernanceTabs
operations.summary: The ways to look at leaders (elected, nominated, appointed) and the bodies to switch to, all read from the reference schemes.

operations.name: GetGovernanceTree
operations.summary: A tree of leaders for one tab or one body: nodes with their tier, how they got the seat, a performance bar and the reference codes behind them; edges from superior to deputy or body to member; and a side rail of the levels of government.

operations.name: GetIndicatorMap
operations.summary: One indicator's latest value for each unit under a parent, for a heat map.

operations.name: GetIndicatorSeries
operations.summary: One indicator over time for one place, optionally broken down.

operations.name: GetInstitution
operations.summary: One body: what it is for, what created it (with the Constitution articles or Acts), who leads it, the bodies it belongs to and oversees, and explanatory texts.

operations.name: GetLeaderProfile
operations.summary: A leader: offices, contacts, media, voting and attendance record, the fund they oversee and evidence.

operations.name: GetLeaderTree
operations.summary: The leaders above and at a place, as a family tree: national first, then county, constituency and ward, split into elected, appointed and nominated.

operations.name: GetLeaderboard
operations.summary: Places (or leaders, parties) ranked by one metric, within a parent area and a level.

operations.name: GetLegalBasis
operations.summary: The Constitution articles and Acts that establish, authorise or govern one record (a body, an office, a place).

operations.name: GetMotion
operations.summary: One motion with the position of every member (yes, no, abstained, absent), the law or budget it concerns and the tally.

operations.name: GetNearbyProjects
operations.summary: Projects close to a position, nearest first, with status, who built them and the money, so a visitor sees what affects them.

operations.name: GetParty
operations.summary: One party: members list, votes obtained by election and fund allocation.

operations.name: GetPlaceCivic
operations.summary: Civic delivery in a place: fund allocations and spending by class and year, projects with locations, infrastructure and leadership.

operations.name: GetPlaceElections
operations.summary: Elections in a place over time: who won, with what votes, turnout and the registration trend.

operations.name: GetPlaceStatistics
operations.summary: Population and other statistics of a place, by topic, with history, breakdowns and comparison to its parents.

operations.name: GetProject
operations.summary: One project: where, who is responsible, the money, the procurement, pictures and evidence.

operations.name: GlobalSearch
operations.summary: One search over places, leaders, parties, projects, tenders, indicators, sources and laws; every hit says what it is.

operations.name: ListContent
operations.summary: Explanatory texts by category or tag, for the Learn section.

operations.name: ListElections
operations.summary: Every election the system knows, newest first.

operations.name: ListFacts
operations.summary: Did-you-know facts about the country, and those tagged to a place and the places above it.

operations.name: ListInstitutions
operations.summary: Every public body grouped by arm of government and kind, with what created it and how many leaders it has. The groups and labels come from the reference schemes.

operations.name: ListLeaderboardMetrics
operations.summary: What places can be ranked by: statistics, finance, civic delivery, procurement and elections.

operations.name: ListMotions
operations.summary: Motions, bills and decisions of public bodies, newest first.

operations.name: ListParties
operations.summary: Political parties ranked by members, votes and fund allocation.

operations.name: ListTenders
operations.summary: Tenders and contracts: open, ongoing, closed, awarded and complete, with suppliers, plus transparency information.

operations.name: BrowseSources
operations.summary: The data sources behind the platform, with their publisher and how many artifacts and citations each has.

operations.name: GetEvidence
operations.summary: One citation with its source, edition, quoted text and the files it points at.

operations.name: GetLocality
operations.summary: The same place document for a known feature, for visitors who pick a place by name instead of position.

operations.name: ListLanguages
operations.summary: The languages the system can serve names and labels in, for a language picker.

operations.name: ResolveLocality
operations.summary: Who and what serves the place at a position: the containing units, the office holders scoped to them, procurement there, media and the evidence for each claim, in the requested language.

operations.name: SearchLocalities
operations.summary: Places whose name matches the text, in any language, narrowest units first.

operations.name: BrowseSchemeMembers
operations.summary: Page through the members of one scheme, including superseded members.

operations.name: BrowseSchemes
operations.summary: Page through classification schemes in code order.

operations.name: LookupMember
operations.summary: Find one classification member from its code (codes are unique across every scheme).
